name: Cookies Addons Blocks
description: COOKiES add-on that withholds placed Drupal blocks (chosen by block ID) behind cookie consent, showing a placeholder overlay and AJAX-loading the block once the matching cookies service is accepted.
project_description: Submodule of Cookies Addons. Blocks placed Drupal blocks (identified by block ID) until the visitor consents to a configured COOKiES service, then loads the block via AJAX. Useful for blocks that embed external services such as maps or social feeds. Configure at /admin/config/system/cookies-addons-blocks.
